preconditions.description: The length of the array A must be between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < len(A) for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in A must be distinct integers within the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(set(A[i] for i in range(len(A)))) for i in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: The return value must be the maximum length of any set S formed by following the indices in A.
